references.title: DWDS: Laster
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for das Laster, the vice; Herkunft ahd. lastar (8th c.), from a lost verb ahd. lahan 'tadeln', not from Last

notes.rationale: The vice, das Laster. DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root laster and the zero ending (ADR 0051). der Laster, the lorry, splits Last + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
